$3.12M FOR PIPELINE RENEWAL

Austin City Council approved a construction contract on November 5 for the West Congress (Radam/St. Elmo) Water and Wastewater Pipeline Renewal Project.

The authorization includes $2,837,732 for construction with Facilities Rehabilitation Inc., plus a $283,774 contingency. The total contract ceiling is $3,121,506, funded through Austin Water’s capital budget.

For nearby homeowners and residents, this is an infrastructure investment behind everyday water and wastewater service—a part of housing that rarely appears in a listing photo.

The approved amount includes contingency; it is not a final project cost. This Council action alone does not establish a construction completion date, announce a household rate increase or confirm additional housing capacity.

Residents should watch for project-specific construction and service notices as work moves forward.

Source: City of Austin, November 5, 2026 Council action notes, Item 5. The Clerk records approval on consent; action notes remain preliminary until formal minutes are approved.
